title: Agnus Castus
text: The most effective use of Agnus is in cases of sexual debility and loss of sexual power. It is indicated in both sexes for these conditions. There is a general lack of vital force, with coldness of the body. Premature old age. Absent-minded. Forgetful. Depression and anxiety. Fears death. Dull headache, especially in the forehead. Vertigo. Pupils dilated. Dimness of vision. Appetite poor. Nausea. Heaviness in the stomach. Distended with gas. Rumbling. Sexual debility. Coldness of the genitals. Yellow discharge from the urethra. Leucorrhoea, with a sensation of coldness. Loss of sexual desire. Itching and burning. Yellow spots on the skin. Compare: Selenium; Phosphorus; Caladium. First to sixth potency.
